newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: SOCCER-THAILAND WIN 1-0 TO TAKE FIRST TIGER CUP.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-THAILAND WIN 1-0 TO TAKE FIRST TIGER CUP.

text.p: Thailand beat Malaysia 1-0 to win the inaugural Tiger Cup in Singapore on Sunday.
The Thais, always favourites to win the southeast Asian tournament, went ahead through Kiatisuk Senmuang and dominated the match without increasing their lead.
They collected $80,000 for their triumph as well as the new trophy. Thai striker Natipong Sritong-in was the tournament's top scorer with seven goals from six matches.
Vietnam took third place by beating Indonesia 3-2 thanks to goals from Hyunh Quoc Cuong, Vo Hoang Buu, and an own goal from Yeyen Tumena.
